copy.shortDescription: This premium beachfront property presents an exceptional opportunity for investors seeking a luxury hospitality asset in the world-renowned destination of El Nido. With its prime location, expansive land area, and strong tourism potential, the resort offers excellent opportunities for further development and long-term value appreciation.
description: A rare investment opportunity in one of the Philippines' premier tourist destinations. Ora Beach Resort is a beachfront resort located in the peaceful Corong Corong area of El Nido, Palawan, offering stunning sunset views and convenient access to the town center and nearby island-hopping attractions. The resort features modern accommodations, swimming pools, a restaurant, fitness facilities, and direct beach access, making it an attractive destination for both local and international travelers
highlights: Prime Beachfront Location in El Nido, one of the Philippines' most sought-after island destinations.
Direct access to a white-sand beach with panoramic views of turquoise waters and dramatic limestone islands.
Existing resort operation with established hospitality infrastructure.
Convenient access to El Nido Airport and the town center, providing excellent connectivity for guests.
